screenshots.alt: Dashboard showing stopped services, virtual hosts and recent logs

screenshots.alt: Import file picker and review confirmation
screenshots.caption: Choose a dump file and review its target database before starting the import.

screenshots.alt: Local database list with search and management controls
screenshots.caption: Select a database to view its tables or manage its backups.

screenshots.alt: Local HTTPS status and certificate trust controls
